label: Household contents insurance: a theft claim

contract.scope: Household contents insurance (Schweizer Hausrat-/Haushaltversicherung): a theft claim under a private-market VVG policy, from occurrence of a theft affecting insured household contents to the insurer's terminal disposition (pay / reduce / decline) and the post-declination time limits. Contractual spine: CSS 519_d AVB 02.2024, the SVV 2022 model wording, Simpego Home 12.2024, AXA Haushaltversicherung 10.2021, Generali Haushaltversicherung; overlaid by VVG (SR 221.229.1) on notification, rescue, alteration, substantiation, fraud, maturity, breach sanctions and limitation. Ordering the sources genuinely impose: (1) occurrence of a covered event triggers the whole duty set (CSS cl. 8 opening; VVG 38(1)); (2) notification to the insurer and, on the theft branch only, notification of the police and preservation of the Tatspuren precede determination of the loss, because the Veraenderungsverbot runs "Bevor der Schaden ermittelt ist" (VVG 38b(1)) and the police-consent condition attaches to the same window (CSS cl. 8(f)); (3) classification as theft precedes and opens the additional theft duties ("Bei Diebstahl hat der Versicherungsnehmer ferner:"); (4) conclusive proof of the theft by traces, witnesses or circumstances is a cover condition preceding quantification, since only a loss so proven is insured at all (CSS cl. 23.3); (5) substantiation precedes determination of quantum, which precedes maturity, because maturity runs only from the moment the insurer has the information from which it can satisfy itself of the claim's correctness (VVG 41(1)); (6) declination precedes and triggers the contractual forfeiture period, which nonetheless runs from the event, not from the declination (SVV E9). Out of scope: the internal police procedure for taking or issuing a theft report; insurer-internal fraud triage; the loss adjuster's method; the cantonal-monopoly fire/elemental fork.

decisions.must_determine: Whether an event covered by the policy has occurred at all: a peril listed in the conditions AND selected in the policy has materialised affecting insured household contents. terminals: T1 Indemnity paid in full: the insurer has received the information from which it can satisfy itself of the correctness of the claim, no suspension applies, and the four-week (AXA: thirty-day) maturity period has expired. Authority: vvg-art-41-para1-20240101-de; css-avb-519d-0224-cl30.

T2 Indemnity reduced: a duty was breached culpably, the breach influenced the occurrence, extent or ascertainment of the loss, and the claimant neither shows blamelessness nor proves absence of causal influence. The reduction is measured by the influence, not by the gravity of the breach. Authority: vvg-art-45-para1-20240101-de; axa-haushalt-1021-J4-1; css-avb-519d-0224-cl29c.

T3 Indemnity reduced on the anticipated-loss measure of a specific breach: late notification reduces by the amount by which the indemnity would have been smaller had notice been timely; breach of the Rettungspflicht reduces by the amount by which it would have been smaller had the duty been met. Authority: vvg-art-38-para2-20240101-de; vvg-art-38a-para2-20240101-de.
T4 Reduced proportionately for underinsurance, subject to the contractual waiver up to a stated loss amount and to the Erstes-Risiko exception. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl22; svv-hausrat-2022-E5.
T5 No cover, because the theft cannot be conclusively established by traces, witnesses or the circumstances. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl23-3; svv-hausrat-2022-B2-3.

T6 No cover, because the loss falls under an exclusion: the perpetrator lived in the policyholder's household; the loss was a losing, mislaying or misappropriation; Geldwerte or the insured Kosten heads were taken by simple theft; simple theft away from the insured location without the separate additional cover; a scheduled valuable of at least CHF 1'000 for which neither a receipt nor an expert's valuation can be produced. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl23-3; css-avb-519d-0224-cl19; css-avb-519d-0224-cl20; css-avb-519d-0224-cl23-3c; simpego-home-1224-B10-15.

T7 Indemnity refused for absence of a specified document, where the wording makes the missing document a ground of refusal (Generali: absence of the medical certificate or of the police document). Authority: generali-haushalt-2022-unterlagen.

T8 Insurer not bound by the contract at all: facts excluding or reducing liability were misstated or concealed for the purpose of deception, or the Art. 39 communications were made late or not at all for that purpose; or the Veraenderungsverbot was breached with fraudulent intent. Distinct from T2 in kind, not in degree. Authority: vvg-art-40-20240101-de; vvg-art-38b-para2-20240101-de.

T9 Claim forfeited for failure to make the communications within the period the insurer set in writing under warning of the consequences of default (Verlust des Versicherungsanspruches; Generali: entfaellt die Leistungspflicht). Authority: vvg-art-39-para2-20240101-de; generali-haushalt-2022-E122.
T10 Claim time-barred five years after the fact giving rise to liability. Authority: vvg-art-46-para1-20240101-de.
T11 Rights forfeited two years after the event where the wording carries the post-declination forfeiture and the claimant has not sued in court. Authority: svv-hausrat-2022-E9.
T12 Amount fixed bindingly by the Sachverstaendigenverfahren, subject only to a party proving that the findings deviate materially from the real state of affairs. Authority: svv-hausrat-2022-F3.
T13 Interim: first part-payment of the amount established by the state of the determination, four weeks (AXA: thirty days) after the loss. Authority: svv-hausrat-2022-E8; generali-haushalt-2022-F14.

T14 Interim: statutory advance up to the undisputed amount where the insurer contests liability or the split among several claimants is unresolved. Authority: vvg-art-41a-para1-20240101-de; vvg-art-41a-para2-20240101-de.

T15 Suspended: maturity does not occur while entitlement is unclear, while police or investigating authorities are investigating and proceedings against the policyholder or claimant are unconcluded, or while the indemnity cannot be determined or paid through the claimant's own culpable conduct. A holding state, not a disposition. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl30; svv-hausrat-2022-E8.

T16 Post-payment unwind: stolen items are recovered and the claimant repays the indemnity, less compensation for repairs or diminution in value, or surrenders the items to the insurer. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl29e; simpego-home-1224-A5-8.

T17 Contract terminated in consequence of the loss: by the insurer at the latest on payment, or by the policyholder within fourteen days of learning of the payment; or, on fraudulent substantiation, by termination or rescission. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl9a; css-avb-519d-0224-cl10; svv-hausrat-2022-G2.

T18 Single recovery across multiple insurances: where other insurance covers the same items and perils, the claim exists once in total across all of them. Authority: css-avb-519d-0224-cl29d; svv-hausrat-2022-G8.
unsupported_but_material: What the police actually require in order to take a theft report, and what a Polizeirapport contains or how a claimant obtains a copy of it. Settled negative: the Suisse ePolice theft wizard is gated, the page returns no readable public content beyond its title, and the survey records that everything past the first triage step sits behind registration. The contract therefore stops at 'the claimant must produce a police report evidencing the four particulars the claim form demands', and must not model the police process itself.

Any numeric day-count for notifying the INSURER attributable to statute. VVG Art. 38(1) supplies only a relative dual-knowledge trigger; every number in this scope ('umgehend', 'sofort', 'unverzueglich', and the 24-hour SIM clock) is a contract fact. A reconstruction that attaches a statutory day-count to notification asserts something no source supports.
Insurer-internal fraud triage: how an insurer decides to escalate a theft claim, what indicators it uses, and at what point it instructs an investigator. No public passage in this corpus.

The loss adjuster's method: how the Ersatzwert of second-hand household goods is actually computed in practice, what depreciation schedules apply, and how 'Sachen, die nicht mehr gebraucht werden' is assessed in the field. The wordings state the rule, not the method.
How the five-year limitation of VVG Art. 46(1) is interrupted or suspended. Art. 46 is silent on interruption and no source in this corpus supplies it.

The evidentiary standard a Swiss court applies to 'Spuren, Zeugen oder nach den Umstaenden schluessig nachgewiesen': what degree of proof 'schluessig' demands, and who carries what burden on it as between the coverage condition and the general burden rule. The wordings state the test without calibrating it.

Photographic evidence of break-in traces. No household-contents wording examined names a photograph as a required document for the theft branch; the only named photograph requirement in this corpus is Generali's, attaching to the bicycle estimate. Modelling 'scene photographs' as a required document would be an invention.

A named invoice document class for the insured cost heads (Notverglasung, Nottueren, Notschloesser, Schlossaenderung, Raeumung und Entsorgung). The wordings say 'effektive Kosten' and impose the general 'Originalbelege' duty, but no wording names an invoice for these heads specifically.
The ombudsman or other out-of-court route for a declined household-contents claim. None of the five wordings names one in the theft context.
Whether and when the insurer must give reasons for a declination. No wording in this corpus imposes a duty to state reasons for declining a household-contents theft claim.

Provenance caveat on the SVV model wording: it is self-described as 'unverbindliche Musterbedingungen', insurers may agree differing terms, and it is reachable only by direct URL rather than from SVV's own index.
